title: Oh No! Empty Table! 🍽️ Set the Table with Baby Ava | Plate, Cup, Spoon | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! The table is empty and it's dinner time! 🍽️ Baby Ava helps set the table all by herself – a pink plate, a blue cup and a yellow spoon. Sing along and learn to help at home!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! Empty table! Dinner time!"
🍽️ A pink plate! Plate, plate, plate! On the table – pat, pat, pat!
🥤 A blue cup! Cup, cup, cup! Clap with Ava!
🥄 A yellow spoon! Spoon, spoon, spoon!
🤔 "What do we need?" – can you say it? Plate, cup, spoon! Yay!
👋 I can help! I set the table! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: setting the table • plate • cup • spoon • colors pink, blue and yellow • helping at home

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A happy dinner-time song for toddlers and preschoolers – perfect for Thanksgiving and every family meal: Baby Ava sets the table step by step, names each thing, pats and claps along and asks you what we need for dinner. After watching, can your little one help set the table too?
